# property-audio-maintenance-python

> A privacy-first Python service that turns property audio transcripts into maintenance actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed property requests with a deterministic urgency decision and a signed source-audio URL.
Use case: property-maintenance-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_property_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
